Method of Attack: Uses a fake reCaptcha prompt to trick users into bypassing browser warnings to download a malicious executable
Executable creates a folder under %AppData%\Bouncy for .NET Helper and installs files including BouncyDotNet.exe which launches PowerShell commands
PowerShell commands compile a .NET application using CSC.exe that launches a DLL for the Ursnif banking trojan
Steals account credentials, downloads further malware, and executes remote commands
Attack Vector: Malicious URL embedded in a fake YouTube video site that triggers download of console-play.exe
Indicators of Compromise: Use of PowerShell commands and CSC.exe compiler
Fake reCaptcha prompt requiring keyboard input to bypass browser warnings
